u&yesterday.uk.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
u&yesterday.uk.description: Sofia to Istanbul: Armed with his 1913 Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo travels from Sofia to Istanbul along part of the route taken by the Orient Express. S4 Ep1

u&yesterday.uk.title: Teleshopping
u&yesterday.uk.description: Shopping from Home.

u&yesterday.uk.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys

u&yesterday.uk.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
u&yesterday.uk.description: Pisa to Lake Garda: Michael Portillo experiences first-hand Italy's 'need for speed' in a Maserati sports car, and discovers how the leaning tower of Pisa was rescued from near collapse. S4 Ep3

u&yesterday.uk.title: Great Canal Journeys

u&yesterday.uk.title: Great Canal Journeys
u&yesterday.uk.description: Leeds and Liverpool: Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on a journey into their pasts via the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, which celebrated its 200th anniversary in 2016. S4 Ep3

u&yesterday.uk.title: Michael Palin: Travels of a Lifetime
u&yesterday.uk.description: Michael Palin looks back on the making of Pole to Pole, in which he travelled along a single line of longitude across the USSR, Africa and finally into Antarctica. S1 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Train Rescue Down Under
u&yesterday.uk.description: Cane Train Rescue: A locomotive needs a quick double bogie change to get back to the sugarcane harvest. Meanwhile, the heat is on for a tricky air conditioner replacement. S1 Ep4

u&yesterday.uk.title: Flipping Bangers
u&yesterday.uk.description: Spitfire: Will and Gus head to London to buy a '73 Mk 4 Spitfire. It seems solid, but how it fares on the road remains to be seen. S1 Ep1

u&yesterday.uk.title: Flipping Bangers
u&yesterday.uk.description: Golf: Will and Gus head to the West Country to buy a Golf GTI. Gus hates it on sight, but Will is smitten. They soon discover why the car is laid up - it has no engine. S1 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
u&yesterday.uk.description: Aynho Wharf to Bablock Hythe: Robbie navigates the Oxford Canal, bumps into a hire boat and a hedge and tackles large river locks on the scenic Upper River Thames. S6 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
u&yesterday.uk.description: Oxford to Reading: Robbie's narrowboat gets a makeover before he explores the River Thames, he moors in Abingdon and tackles an emergency DIY repair to fix a leak. S6 Ep3

u&yesterday.uk.title: Saving Lives at Sea
u&yesterday.uk.description: Every Second Counts: A fisherman is dragged lifeless out of the sea by bystanders and the lifeboat crew race to the beach to join the desperate attempts to resuscitate him. S9 Ep3

u&yesterday.uk.title: Blue Planet II
u&yesterday.uk.description: Green Seas: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning in a rocky reef and tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in seagrass. S2 Ep5

u&yesterday.uk.title: Blue Planet II
u&yesterday.uk.description: Coasts: Footage of animals that live on the coast, including sea lions hunting for tuna, puffins bringing food back to their young, and a strange species of fish that hates water. S2 Ep6

u&yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics

u&yesterday.uk.title: New: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
u&yesterday.uk.description: Cortina/Maxi: The team cop for a 1965 Ford Cortina Estate, supposedly owned by a South African Chief of Police, and take on one of Dave's guilty pleasures: a 1980s Austin Morris Max. S9 Ep1

u&yesterday.uk.title: Classic Car Kings
u&yesterday.uk.description: Lamborghini Espada: Irv restores a 1970s Lamborghini Espada for a client in the Middle East. Hidden structural damage and spiralling engine issues threaten the entire project. S1 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
u&yesterday.uk.description: A35/BMW Z3: The team take on one of Derek's favourites - an Austin A35 - but its age ensures some hefty bills. To bank some cash, their second project is a quick flip - a 1999 BMW Z3. S8 Ep6

u&yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
u&yesterday.uk.description: Land Rover S1/Bentley Mulsanne: Paul and daughter Kate collect a Series 1 Land Rover, while Jack collects an unusual wartime paratrooper's bike in Scarborough. S12 Ep4

u&yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash

bbconemidlands.uk.description: S28 Love Nest by the Lake An update on a new build in Staffordshire as it reaches it conclusion, plus visits to properties in south-east London and Greater Manchester. Presented Jacqui Joseph and Dion Dublin.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S75 E16 Ardingly 16 Natasha Raskin Sharp hosts as two teams scour Ardingly antiques fair in West Sussex and pick up bargains to sell for profit at auction under the guidance of Caroline Hawley and Thomas Forrester. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S23 E10 Anglesey Jules Hudson helps a couple from a town in Cheshire to find their dream home on Anglesey. During a busy week of house-hunting, Jules turns his attention away from property and heads to the Welsh mainland to catch up with a passionate farmer, Gareth Wyn Jones, whose family has been working the land for 375 years.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Garden Rescue
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S11 E31 Stourbridge Charlie Dimmock and Florence Headlam travel to Stourbridge to help Vicki and Mark transform their barren garden into a stunning bumblebee haven. With only a towering copper beech tree to work around, the couple dream of creating a stylish yet welcoming outdoor retreat for dining, entertaining and relaxation.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E1 Ross Kemp presents a celebrity edition of the high-stakes quiz, with Sam Quek, Dion Dublin, Joanna Page and Melvin Odoom playing to win money for their chosen charities. They must cross the bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E29 Quiz show in which five pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Andi Oliver.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Wildfires: A Warning from the Midlands
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Following the wildfires that destroyed 38 homes in the Midlands in August 2026, Mary Rhodes meets residents, firefighters and experts to examine what lessons can be learnt from one of the UK's most destructive recent wildfire events. With scientists predicting that climate change will increase the frequency and severity of wildfires in the UK, are current warning systems fit for purpose.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Celebrity Traitors

There's also an appearance from Colin Farrell talking about new documentary The Slightest Touch, about skin-disease campaigner Emma Fogarty. eden.uk.plus1.description: Isolated since the time of the dinosaurs, New Zealand's wildlife has been left to its own devices - with surprising consequences. While caught up in the chaos are Ryan Gosling, Stephen Fry, Damian Lewis, Alison Hammond, Alan Titchmarsh, Amanda Holden and many more, the cock-ups include an alpaca using the This Morning studio floor as a toilet. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 2026

itvcentral.uk.title: Emmerdale
itvcentral.uk.description: In the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, residents of a farm and the nearby village deal with all the drama, joys and heartbreaks life throws at them. (Drama, Soap) - 2026

itvcentral.uk.title: Coronation Street
itvcentral.uk.description: The working-class residents of Coronation Street see their fair share of drama as they make their way about their daily lives. (Drama, Romance, Soap) - 2026

itvcentral.uk.title: Beat the Chasers
itvcentral.uk.description: Bradley Walsh hosts as five contestants from across the country - Ellie May, Yinka, Carl, Helen and Charles - look to win big money, but they will have to take down six of the best - The Sinnerman, The Beast, The Governess, The Menace, The Vixen and The Dark Destroyer - to do so. (Entertainment, Game show) - 2025

itvcentral.uk.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018)
itvcentral.uk.description: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet. - 2018

itvcentral.uk.title: Teleshopping
itvcentral.uk.description: Shopping from home.

itvcentral.uk.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
itvcentral.uk.description: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence. (Documentary, Crime) - 2025

itvcentral.uk.title: Unwind with ITV
itvcentral.uk.description: A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

itvcentral.uk.title: Deal or No Deal - Matt
itvcentral.uk.description: Join Stephen Mulhern as Matt gets his opportunity to open the iconic red boxes - in the game show with only one question, Matt must either say 'Deal' or 'No deal' when faced with the Banker's tempting offers. (Game show) - 2025

itvcentral.uk.title: Casino Royale (1967)
itvcentral.uk.description: Spoof in which Sir James Bond is brought out of retirement to save the world from the machinations of the criminal organisation SMERSH. Reluctant to return to the dangers of his old lifestyle, he hands his licence to kill to his nephew. (Comedy) - 1967

itvcentral.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Lafayette
itvcentral.uk.description: James Martin's American Adventure continues with a drive towards Louisiana's swamplands, where he ditches his car for a high-speed boat! The unique watery wonderland provides James with the perfect location to cook a stunning recipe. All he has to do is make sure that he avoids the alligators! James also discovers nearby Lafayette, a city with a great foodie legacy, where he visits family-run smokehouse Johnson's Boucaniere. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvcentral.uk.title: ITV News
itvcentral.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvcentral.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvcentral.uk.description: James Martin is cooking two vegan dishes for the hugely popular comedian and TV presenter Sara Pascoe. His guest chefs are Francesco Mazzei and Richard Bertinet, alongside a new chef to the show - two-Michelin-starred Allister Barsby.

itvcentral.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - The Big Gathering
itvcentral.uk.description: Clodagh's throwing a big gathering for friends and family in her garden with a super easy menu. There's a great green speedy garden herb dip, crowd-pleasing chocolate beef chilli that's next-level delicious and a showstopping French classic tarte Tatin using a Clodagh favourite shortcut, shop-bought puff pastry. There are cocktails and an impressive table setting mixing vegetables and flowers, both perfect for Clodagh's fun get-together.

itvcentral.uk.title: ITV News
itvcentral.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvcentral.uk.title: ITV Racing Live - Ascot
itvcentral.uk.description: Francesca Cumani and Ed Chamberlin present seven races at Ascot on Champions Day. The final day of the UK flat season will see young jockey Billy Loughnane crowned Champion jockey in amongst a superb day of racing with plenty of top-level action including the feature Queen Elizabeth II Stakes for the milers and the Champion Stakes itself. Analysis from Jason Weaver, Ruby Walsh and Adele Mulrennan, reporting from Matt Chapman, Luke Harvey and Oli Bell, and commentary from Richard Hoiles. (Horse)

itvcentral.uk.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars

itvcentral.uk.title: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery

itvcentral.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
amc.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.us.title: The Omen
amc.us.description: American diplomat Robert (Gregory Peck) adopts Damien (Harvey Stephens) when his wife, Katherine (Lee Remick), delivers a stillborn child. After Damien's first nanny hangs herself, Father Brennan (Patrick Troughton) warns Robert that Damien will kill Katherine's unborn child. Shortly thereafter, Brennan dies and Katherine miscarries when Damien pushes her off a balcony. As more people around Damien die, Robert investigates Damien's background and realizes his adopted son may be the Antichrist. (Horror, Thriller) - 1976

amc.us.title: The Amityville Horror
amc.us.description: Chiller about a family who is terrorized by supernatural forces when they move into a new house in New York State which was the scene of a recent mass killing and the home of an 18th-century satanist. When swarms of flies appear from nowhere and the pipes and walls begin to ooze slime and blood, they call on a local priest to exorcize the evil spirits. (Horror) - 1979

amc.us.title: The Amityville Horror
amc.us.description: When George Lutz (Ryan Reynolds) and his wife, Kathy (Melissa George), find a beautiful new house in the small town of Amityville, N.Y., they think the place is too good to be true. After they move in with their kids, they find out the cheap price tag is thanks to the house's sordid history: The former tenant murdered his family after supposedly being possessed by the devil. Believing the home is haunted, the couple find a priest (Philip Baker Hall) to help them rid the place of evil spirits. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: The Omen
amc.us.description: A new age of evil threatens to arise when an American diplomat (Liev Schreiber) and his wife (Julia Stiles) learn that the child (Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick) they adopted may be the son of Satan. Mystical signs point to the Antichrist's coming battle for dominion over heaven and Earth. (Horror) - 2006

amc.us.title: Insidious
amc.us.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg: The China Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.

bloomberg.us.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: The definitive guide for global news audiences to get the complete picture on the story of the day, through probing interviews and nuanced conversations.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: A spotlight on the fast-paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa, linking the market drivers from overnight in the U.S. and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep-dive analysis of the top businesses.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break-down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.

bloomberg.us.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Based in London, Francine Lacqua speaks with guests about global business, economics, finance and politics.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Brief ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: "Bloomberg Brief" delivers the market news, data and analysis viewers need to set their agendas.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Surveillance ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Jonathan, Lisa and Annmarie survey the economy and global markets with daily conversations with leaders and decision makers, from Wall Street to Washington and beyond, to cover the latest in business, investment and geopolitics.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Open Interest ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Money ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Breaking news and projections before the start of the business day.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Focusing on the intersection of politics and global business.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec bring reporting from the magazine that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends shaping today's complex economy.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg: The Close ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Romaine Bostick and Katie Greifeld break down the day's top market-moving stories and trading action around the closing bell.

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Focusing on the intersection of politics and global business.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Coming Together in Cali
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy visits Chico, Calif., celebrating the town's food scene as residents recover from ravaging fires; a wood-fired Italian spot cooks up pork ragù; a bakery serves up savory specialties like black bean chili; a pub serves a "Pho-rench Dip."

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Eating Alaska
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Family Meals
foodnetwork.us.description: Two brothers-in-law carry on a decades-long seafood tradition; a mother-son duo running a breakfast, lunch and dinner joint in honor of their Pop; father-son meat masters firing up killer char-becue.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Lots of Latin
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is loading up on all kinds of Latin on this trip; in Logan, Utah, a Salvadoran spot puttin' out pupusas and a cabeza creation.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Authentic to Inventive
foodnetwork.us.description: Dishes from real deal to really creative; in Portland, Ore., a 70-year-old icon is serving up authentic Chinese recipes from the chef's hometown; a restaurant in Oklahoma City is cooking chicken and biscuits.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meat and Heat
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri rolls into a tucked-away panini paradise in Chehalis, Wash.; a Korean spot in Brentwood, Tenn., gets spicy with its chicken and bulgogi; in Houston, a barbecue joint throws Tex-Mex into the mix with brisket tacos and jalapeño sausage.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Appetizers to Dessert
foodnetwork.us.description: In Laramie, Wyo., an old-school café has green chili burritos and pie; a spot in Anchorage, Alaska has blackened chicken gnocchi.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Thai, Pie and Fries
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's diving into Thai food, pie and hearty fries; in San Diego, a spot is serving fish and ribs; in Arroyo Seco, N.M., a New Zealand food truck makes meat pies; a cozy joint loads up bison chili fries.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Mexican, Mediterranean and Mofongo
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's grabbing an international playlist of flavor; in Florida, a funky spot is putting a Mediterranean spin on burgers, while a local gem is dishing out Puerto Rican specialties; in Las Vegas, a real deal Mexican joint has bomb birria tacos.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Champion Chefs
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's visiting restaurants owned by familiar Food Network faces; in Studio City, Calif., chef Antonia Lofaso is cooking up global flavors, and in Rapid City, S.D., chef Justin Warner is serving up righteous ramen and dynamite dumplings.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwiches, Sausage & Sweets
foodnetwork.us.description: Savoring sammies, sausage, and sweets; a funky Filipino joint in Sacramento, Calif., is making cookies; a West Palm Beach, Fla., spot is smoking gator sausage; an elevated eatery in Tampa, Fla., is plating an out-of-bounds Italian sandwich.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Buns, Burgers and Bolognese
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's digging into pork dumplings from a husband-and-wife team in Sacramento, Calif.; a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla. Bistro is mixing up a meat sauce; a mom-and-pop shop in San Jose, Calif. Serves up black bean burgers.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Triple D Nation: Beef It Up ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: Fieri's headed back to some top spots, starting with an Austin, TX, institution scratch-making garden enchiladas; in Reno, NV, a BBQ joint is putting out mouthwatering meatloaf, and a New Orleans landmark is plating killer catfish with crawfish mac.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef, Bowls, and Burritos
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's getting into next-level bowls, burritos and more!; there's karaage chicken in Rogers, AR, and a Seattle spot is putting a Lebanese spin on tacos and burritos; plus, a joint in Bentonville, AR, is serving a serious smoked French dip.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
foodnetwork.us.description: With roadside diners, vintage drive-ins and out-of-the-way "dives" enjoying a resurgence of hipness among foodies, host Guy Fieri travels across America in search of some of the best "greasy spoon" eateries. The restaurants that Guy visits are usually well-known among locals and other people in the region. While at each location, Fieri talks to the staff as well as the customers to get their thoughts on the food. Many episodes feature eateries that are connected by a common thread, such as burgers or comfort foods. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2007-04-23

foodnetwork.us.title: Girl Meets Farm - Addicted to Chocolate
foodnetwork.us.description: Molly Yeh shares her favorite choco-licious recipes to curb the cravings; she makes s'mores pie, chocolate sea salt rugelach and mini marzipan treats; rich and gooey Turkish coffee brownies will be enough to satisfy any chocolate appetite. (Cooking, Documentary) - 2020-07-05

foodnetwork.us.title: Girl Meets Farm - Must eat Sugar, Molly's Fave Desserts
foodnetwork.us.description: Molly is sharing some of her all-time best dessert recipes, from cookies to squares and definitely donuts in between. (Cooking, Documentary) - 2020-05-17

foodnetwork.us.title: Girl Meets Farm - Molly's Sprinkle!
foodnetwork.us.description: Molly Yeh throws a baby shower on the farm; she makes savory lentil soup in bread bowls and crave-worthy chicken Caesar salad wraps with crispy cheese; for dessert, there are glossy pink glazed yeasted donuts. (Cooking, Documentary) - 2022-02-20

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - How The Cookie Crumbles
foodnetwork.us.description: Chocolate mint iced cookies decorated with swirls of snow-white royal icing; browned butter sugar cookies that become the base for cookie jam pies; next-level chocolate chip cookies with bacon and caramel corn; no bake cookies. (Reality, Cooking) - 2017-12-23

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - The Pie's the Limit
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond is in a pie state of mind, so she starts by making an incredibly decadent and party-worthy Double chocolate pie with a torched meringue topping; a fantastic waffle cone ice cream pie with shortcuts. (Reality, Cooking) - 2019-11-23

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Housewarming Treats
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond prepares fall sweets for visitors at her and her sister's remodeled home, by starting the housewarming with her classic s'mores cookies, shortcut cherry cheesecake brownie cups, easy apple fritters, and pumpkin pie snacking granola. (Reality, Cooking) - 2022-10-15

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Treats for Todd
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond has a care package for her youngest college kid, Todd; she's sending him mini strawberry tarts and chocolate hazelnut oatmeal bars to share with his roommates, cheesy chipotle cheddar snack mix and spirit pretzels in his team colors. (Reality, Cooking) - 2023-08-12

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Sweet Ways to Celebrate
foodnetwork.us.description: Sweet ways to celebrate Valentine's Day; sake and miso-marinated salmon with coconut rice and broccolini; a brownie tart; mint chocolate bonbons. (Cooking) - 2021-02-13

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - The Sweetest Pairings
foodnetwork.us.description: The Kitchen has sweet and exciting flavor pairings, like pomegranate glazed lamb lollipops, endive salad with candied nuts and agrodolce salmon; plus special guest Anne Burrell. (Cooking) - 2022-02-12

foodnetwork.us.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten - Yotam Ottolenghi ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef and restaurateur Yotam Ottolenghi joins Ina Garten to talk about his deli success and the secrets to his groundbreaking recipes. Ina welcomes him with Coconut Cupcakes, and Yotam takes over the kitchen to make his Traybake Chicken with Caesar Salad. (Cooking) - 2026-10-17

foodnetwork.us.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten - Jeffrey Garten

Ina makes Easy Butternut Squash and Apple Soup, and Jeffrey learns to make Challah French Toast. (Cooking) - 2026-10-10

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Eating Up New Orleans
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri takes a tasty tour of New Orleans; he goes to a butcher shop with a funky take on the Big Easy's comfort food flavors, checks out a seafood spot getting creative with their dishes and digs at a real-deal po' boy joint. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2019-03-01

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sausage, Shawarma and Scaloppini
foodnetwork.us.description: A funky Italian joint in Wilmington, Del., serves arancini and veal scaloppini; a Middle Eastern street food spot in San Diego serves shawarma and falafel; a not-your-typical pizza place in Vancouver tops things off with lamb sausage and pig cheeks. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2019-05-31

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sicilian and Seafood
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy goes from incredible Italian to sensational seafood; wood-fired pizza; crab cake cioppino and crab-spinach risotto; Vanilla Ice at a pirate-inspired joint serving up Brazilian and Caribbean seafood specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2020-06-19

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Pig's Feet, Mojo and Chow-Chow
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri dives into unordinary recipes, starting in Palm Beach, Fla., where a hidden restaurant serves up seafood and chow-chow; a funky Filipino joint in Hawaii fires up its spin on pigs' feet. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2021-07-16

foodnetwork.us.description: Waffles in Anchorage, Alaska, and steak tacos in Aspen, Colo.; in Albuquerque, N.M., a Latin place makes arepas and pork paninis. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2022-03-04

fx.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
fx.us.description: Capt. Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) arrives at Port Royal in the Caribbean without a ship or crew. His timing is inopportune, however, because later that evening the town is besieged by a pirate ship. The pirates kidnap the governor's daughter, Elizabeth (Keira Knightley), who's in possession of a valuable coin that is linked to a curse that has transformed the pirates into the undead. A gallant blacksmith (Orlando Bloom) in love with Elizabeth allies with Sparrow in pursuit of the pirates. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2003

fx.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
fx.us.description: When ghostly pirate Davy Jones comes to collect a blood debt, Capt. Jack Sparrow must find a way to avoid his fate lest his soul be damned for all time. Nevertheless, the wily ghost manages to interrupt the wedding plans of Jack's friends Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2006

fx.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
fx.us.description: Will Turner (Orlando Bloom) and Elizabeth Swann (Keira Knightley) join forces with Capt. Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush) to free Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) from Davy Jones' locker. Meanwhile, the crew of the Flying Dutchman ghost ship wreaks havoc on the Seven Seas. The friends must navigate dangerous waters to confront Chinese pirate Sao Feng (Chow Yun-Fat) and, ultimately, they must choose sides in a battle wherein the pirate life hangs in the balance. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2007

fx.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
fx.us.description: Thrust into an all-new adventure, a down-on-his-luck Capt. Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2017

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Two-Fer
motortrend.us.description: The '58 Corvette owner's idea is to top off his collection with a custom CF1, which Dave would love to do; the client's wish is to debut them both together, so Dave now has his work cut out for him.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It's 1200 Miles To Columbus
motortrend.us.description: Dave and Kevin take the '67 Coronet, '55 Gullwing and '63 Corvette to a car show in Columbus, Ohio, where they will compete for street rod of the year.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Back in the Club
motortrend.us.description: Ever since Dave set the market with his Safari bus build, he has been itching to get his hands on another VW and have some fun; this car might be more than he bargained for, as the car itself is a heap of rusty parts and a broken-down engine.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Two-Fer
motortrend.us.description: The '58 Corvette owner's idea is to top off his collection with a custom CF1, which Dave would love to do; the client's wish is to debut them both together, so Dave now has his work cut out for him.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It's 1200 Miles To Columbus
motortrend.us.description: Dave and Kevin take the '67 Coronet, '55 Gullwing and '63 Corvette to a car show in Columbus, Ohio, where they will compete for street rod of the year.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Back in the Club
motortrend.us.description: Ever since Dave set the market with his Safari bus build, he has been itching to get his hands on another VW and have some fun; this car might be more than he bargained for, as the car itself is a heap of rusty parts and a broken-down engine.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - New Year, New Vette
motortrend.us.description: A big fan of Dave's work on Corvettes wants to build his own collection, so the crew jumps into modifying every inch of a '58.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Outlaw
motortrend.us.description: The shop is finally ready to take the Outlaw Porsche to its conclusion; done in metal, the car starts in body and paint, then is ready for assembly.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - British Racing CF1
motortrend.us.description: Dave's CF1 client challenges him to come up with a build plan that incorporates all the bells and whistles of a vintage '60s era British race car, complete with custom color, roll cage, racing straps and new gauges.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - V-8 Baja Bug Suspension Overhaul!
motortrend.us.description: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Drag Racing Model A!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer!
motortrend.us.description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Monte Carlo Circle Track Surprise
motortrend.us.description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
motortrend.us.description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Tough Truck Mail Jeep!
motortrend.us.description: When Grave Digger himself calls you out, there's only one thing to do, send it; the guys send it by transforming a stock 1972 Jeep into a Tough Truck competitor to challenge the field at Dennis Anderson's Muddy Motorsports Park in North Carolina.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Top-Speed Trans Am!
motortrend.us.description: The guys attempt to build their '99 Trans Am into a 200-mph club member to compete at the Arkansas Mile; Keith Turk helps the guys find out how much horsepower they need to make, and they begin one of their most complex builds yet.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pigpen vs. Crown Hick: Battle of the Body Swaps!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take on Hot Rod Garage's Lucky Costa and improve their shop truck Pigpen; it's their LS7-powered 1950 GMC 100 on an S15 chassis versus Lucky's 1966 Ford F-100 with a supercharged 4.6L on a police car chassis known as the Crown Hick.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Shocking Gains and Boosting the '60 Biscayne!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up time against a '66 Mustang GT350.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Hemi-Powered Monte Carlo!
motortrend.us.description: Newbern and Cotten take a G-Body to new heights when they swap a third-gen Hemi into a 1984 Monte Carlo.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - 200mph Trans AM!
motortrend.us.description: What does it take to get a Trans Am to 200 mph? The guys swing for the fences in an attempt at the elusive top speed of 200 mph.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Bootleg Ford Fixing and Road Trip!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich death-proof their questionably assembled '40 Ford Fordor, then hit the road to multiple junkyards to hunt for a new project vehicle; after a lengthy search, they fall in love with a barn-find '60s truck that's too good.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Muscle Truck 4-Link Fabrication!
motortrend.us.description: The '73 Chevy step-side muscle truck has a storied history; Freiburger and guest host Dave Chappelle fabricate another chapter in the truck's saga with the addition of a beefy four-link suspension and coilovers to hopefully get it to sit right.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - 1000+ hp Pro Street Nova!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich add 1,000+ hp to David's Pro Street 1969 Chevy Nova; in an attempt to make a true street/strip car, the guys fully build out this roller before taking it to the track to run some impressive times out of the gate.

sportsnet360.ca.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It's the Bank Holiday weekend and there's plenty to be getting on with in the garden. Monty Don takes stock of what's worked and what hasn't at Longmeadow, with a view to planning ahead to the autumn. Meanwhile, James Wong goes behind the scenes at Bristol Zoo to find out more about how the animals are kept fed throughout the year.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Whilst enjoying the late season colour in the Jewel Garden as the summer begins to fade, Monty Don turns his attention to his spring borders which are in need of refurbishment if they are going to pack a punch early next year.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nations most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a `drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. In the first of a five-part series about botany, Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don is at Longmeadow with a host of seasonal jobs to keep his autumn garden looking beautiful for as long as possible, and in the third of her fascinating films about how plants work, Carol Klein investigates the science of stems.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand foot vegetable garden.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With one of the driest summers in many years, Monty responds to viewers' questions and has plenty of advice on how to deal with drought conditions for vegetables, fruit, flowers and containers. Carol Klein celebrates one of the most flamboyant summer shrubs, the hydrangea.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, the garden is letting them down and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

673498.title: Mackenna's Gold
673498.description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

673498.title: Blazing Across the Pecos
673498.description: The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: The Thrill Hunter
673498.description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

673498.title: The Longest Drive
673498.description: After a decade apart, a pair of brothers reunites to find their long-lost sister, who was kidnapped as a child and is now living with a native tribe.

673498.title: Apache Territory
673498.description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

673498.title: Riding Wild
673498.description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

673498.title: They Rode West
673498.description: Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

673498.title: The Violent Men
673498.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

673498.title: The Black Dakotas
673498.description: A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.

673498.title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
673498.description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

673498.title: The Last Rebel
673498.description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

673500.title: Five Easy Pieces
673500.description: To see his dying father, a man must return to the privileged life he rejected, only to discover he is a stranger both to his family and to himself.

673500.title: From Here to Eternity
673500.description: A World War II classic about the violence, quarrels, and romantic intrigue affecting a group of soldiers at Pearl Harbor before the tragic attack.

673500.title: The Taming of the Shrew
673500.description: A rich merchant's beautiful daughter and her volatile older sister are courted by rival suitors in this rambunctious version of Shakespeare's comedy.

673500.title: The Long Gray Line
673500.description: An Irish immigrant who found a home in the Army as a West Point instructor becomes very close to his pupils, one of whom is Dwight Eisenhower.

673500.title: The Wrecking Crew
673500.description: Super spy Matt Helm, with the help of agent Freya Carlson, travels to Denmark to find the mastermind behind the heist of a billion in US gold bullion.

673500.title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
673500.description: War widow Janet Ames (Rosalind Russell) is struck by a car, and later her doctors suspect she may have been attempting suicide. A note in her pocket lists five men whom her husband died saving in battle, and they are contacted to help Janet's recovery. The first man on the list, jaded reporter Smitty Cobb (Melvyn Douglas), is offended when Janet says she hopes to prove her husband died in vain to save five worthless men, and offers to "introduce" Janet to each of the men through hypnotism.

673500.title: The Magic Carpet
673500.description: When his parents, the caliph and queen, are murdered by usurper Ali (Gregory Gaye), the newborn Ramoth is delivered to the safety of his uncle, Ahkmid (William Fawcett), via a magic carpet. The adult Ramoth (John Agar) becomes masked hero the Scarlet Falcon. After tricking the reigning caliph into appointing him the royal physician, Ramoth learns of his noble birth and, with the help of faithful Razi (George Tobias) and beautiful Lida (Patricia Medina), he fights Ali and his wrathful minions.

673500.title: It Had to Be You
673500.description: Society girl Victoria Stafford (Ginger Rogers) garners a reputation for leaving men at the altar. Getting engaged for a fourth time, Victoria believes she's found the right man -- until on a train she has a strange dream about a Native American who claims that he is her true love. Awakening, Victoria is startled to find the dream man, George (Cornel Wilde), who claims to really exist, while also being a figment of her imagination. Back at home, George guides Victoria to a startling discovery.

673500.title: You Can't Run Away From It
673500.description: A spoiled heiress teams up with an enterprising reporter to escape her domineering father's plan of keeping her from getting married.

673500.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
673500.description: A daughter visits her family to introduce them to her Black fiancé, whose kindness and loving demeanor changes the hearts of her reluctant parents.

692051.title: Creepshow III
692051.description: Macabre tales center on a strange radio, a killer call girl, a haunting, and more in this third installment in an iconic horror anthology series.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: In the near-future when nuclear war has turned much of our world into wasteland, the youth of America have become drug-crazed sociopaths who lawlessly prowl what's left.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: When stressed-out student Walter Gilman rents a room in a decrepit old house, his graduate thesis studies begin to take some very strange twists. He suffers nightmares about a voracious rat with a human face.

692051.title: Nightbreed
692051.description: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

692051.title: Grave Encounters
692051.description: A reality show crew filming inside an abandoned mental hospital realizes that the building is not only haunted, but isn't going to let them leave.

692051.title: Grave Encounters 2
692051.description: Tortured by the ghosts of a demonized insane asylum, film students fight to escape death as their paranormal investigation goes terribly wrong.

692051.title: Dresden Files
692051.description: When a man drops dead in Harry's office, Harry is led to investigate a complex murder plot with ties to Bob's past.

692051.title: Dresden Files
692051.description: Dresden takes on a case pro bono after a woman coming to him for help is killed in front of him, but the investigation leads to dark magic and more death.

692051.title: Day of the Dead
692051.description: A group of scientists and soldiers take refuge in an underground missile silo desperate to control the flesh-eating horror roaming the earth above.

692051.title: Prom Night
692051.description: Six years after a tragic accident, a masked killer hunts the teens responsible, turning their high school prom into a night of terror.

692051.title: Wolf Creek
692051.description: Realizing they are being targeted by Mick, the group make their way towards a hill in search of water and civilization. But as they bicker and fight, Mick closes in.

692051.title: Wolf Creek
692051.description: Steve is rescued by two indigenous stockmen, only to find that they are hunted by Mick. Still reeling with Michelle’s death, the group struggle on as Nina gets bitten by a snake.

692051.title: Rabid (1977)
692051.description: An experimental surgery leaves an injured motorcyclist with a thirst for human blood, spreading a disease that turns people into ravenous monsters.

692051.title: Bloodsucking Bastards
692051.description: An overworked employee at a bleak telemarketing company discovers his nemesis is a scheming vampire who is turning their coworkers into the undead.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: While left alone in an isolated house, a young writer suffering from terrifying visions during sleep paralysis realizes that these hallucinations may actually be a life-threatening reality.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: Family man is in a bad accident. As he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him. When he comes to, the family man looks like the serial killer and the cops don't believe his story.

692051.title: Grizzly
692051.description: A bloodthirsty grizzly bear stalks two estranged brothers (James Marsden, Thomas Jane) in the Alaskan wilderness.

692087.title: I Used to Love Her
692087.description: A story of pursuing integrity amid adversity, this film centers around a couple's challenging journey as they bootstrap an indie recording company.

692087.title: Measure of Faith
692087.description: A family’s faith is tested after the death of their grandmother and matriarch reveals secrets and betrayals.

692087.title: Savage Girls
692087.description: Jillian returns to Watts after a troubled military discharge. Finding her family in hardship, she plans a risky heist, but survival has a deadly cost.

692087.title: Uncle P

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A New Jersey State Trooper is shot to death on the side of Interstate 80 near the Pennsylvania border. Witnesses to the shooting identify the shooter's car. Police issue an APB, and locate the vehicle hours later. Fingerprinting of the vehicle points to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges. Authorities who inspect the fugitive's home find some incriminating evidence including a box of bullets linked to the Trooper's murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring. He never came home. Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI. Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black. Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Four inmates from a Delaware Correctional Center turn up missing in the middle of the night. A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On December 21, 1998, two gunmen kidnap three janitors on their way to clean the Bank of America ATM repository in Las Vegas. The gunmen force the janitors to let them in the ATM repository and hold them hostage until the armored car guards arrive to make their nightly collection. When the guards enter the bank, the gunmen surprise them and shoot one guard in the chest before escaping with $1,088,000, the largest bank robbery take in Las Vegas history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000. The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000. As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg. After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

abcsydney.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 3 When Kelby's old friend Emily becomes the target of threatening texts the team must act fast to uncover who's hiding behind the screen. With Humphrey busy at home Kelby steps up to help Esther with the investigation.

abcsydney.au.title: Death Valley
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E6 Death Valley - S John and Janie unravel a mystery involving a murder at a school reunion, a cold case, and a shocking discovery from Janie's past. John risks their friendship with unexpected news. (Final).

abcsydney.au.title: You Can't Ask That
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E7 Fat This episode sets the record straight about what it's really like to be judged as fat. Find out the answers to the questions Australians wanted to ask but were too embarrassed or afraid to ever ask in person.

abcsydney.au.title: Grand Designs: House Of The Year ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: S8 E1 Episode 1 From storm-lashed islands to cliff-carved retreats and collapsing hillsides, Kevin McCloud reveals homes built against the odds in the new series of House of the Year.

abcsydney.au.title: null ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: Boyer Lecture 2026: Sam Roggeveen Program Director of the Lowy Institute's International Security Program, Sam Roggeveen delivers the 2026 Boyer Lecture exploring the opportunities and challenges of Australia's engagement with Asia in the 21st Century.

abcsydney.au.title: Martin Clunes' Islands of the Atlantic
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E1 Sao Tome + Principe and Bijagos Islands In the first episode, Martin Clunes explores tropical Sao Tome and Principe, known as the African Galapagos, and encounters some fearsome predators and powerful women on the remote Bijagos Islands.

abcsydney.au.title: Australian Story
abcsydney.au.description: E33 A Second Start - Katie Noonan In 2024, acclaimed singer Katie Noonan's life fell apart when she split with her husband. Her new album reflects the grief of separation but is tempered with lyrics about falling in love, gifted to her by writer Trent Dalton.

abcsydney.au.title: Landline
abcsydney.au.description: E35 Episode 35 A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

abcsydney.au.title: Kath & Kim
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E5 Old Kim makes Kath feel self conscious about her age so she invests in the new homeboy fashion range. Kath is upset when Kel stands her up several times. Kim maintains her treat-'em-mean-keep-'em-keen campaign with Brett.

abcsydney.au.title: Hard Quiz
abcsydney.au.description: S3 E14 Episode 14 Liv thinks Thunderbirds are go, Matt's cheering for the Sydney Swans, Brad reckons Rubik's Cubes are ripper, and Mark's nuts for nuclear physics. Tom thinks they're all a bit sad. Watch #HardQuiz and judge for yourselves.

abcsydney.au.title: ABC News ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E290 Saturday 17 October 2026 News from where we live. ABC News NSW brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on issues that matter to you. Presented by Lydia Feng, and sport with Niav Owens.

abcsydney.au.title: Beyond Paradise ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 A local chocolatier falls under suspicion when three customers are poisoned after sampling her confections. Humphrey must explore every avenue to determine whether she orchestrated the attack or was framed.

abcsydney.au.title: Lynley ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E2 This Body of Death Lynley and Havers are assigned to a missing person case of a young estate agent with ties to Lynley's former classmate Helen Cylde, but as the clock ticks station chief DCI Nies pressures them to arrest a suspect.

abcsydney.au.title: Darby and Joan
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 When Jack takes a detour to help an old mate recover some stolen guns, he and Joan learn there's more to the robbery than it first appeared. and Joan begins to suspect that there is more to Jack than he's letting on.

abcsydney.au.title: The Forsytes
abcsydney.au.description: S2 E1 Tvillingskjebner As London reawakens for the new season, Soames dreams of fatherhood while Jolyon Jnr faces the daunting prospect of reconnecting with the Forsytes.

abcsydney.au.title: Rage: Guest Programmer ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E42 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. Guest programmers curate an all-night playlist of their all-time favourite clips.

abcsydney.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E42 Keep the party vibe going as the sun comes up with continuous music videos, from new releases to classics and the songs we've long forgotten.

abcsydney.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E42 Keep the party vibe going with wall-to-wall music videos, from new releases to classics and the long-forgotten.

abcsydney.au.title: Weekend Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E84 Sunday 18 October 2026 All the news you need to start your Sunday. Johanna Nicholson and Melissa Mackay bring you the latest news, interviews, politics, culture, weather and global affairs. Plus sport with Daniela Intili.

abcsydney.au.title: Insiders ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E38 For 25 years, Insiders remains the leading destination for political analysis and commentary. David Speers and the panel discuss the past sitting week in federal parliament and the issues on the political agenda this week.

abcsydney.au.title: Offsiders ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E37 Abbey Gelmi and the panel discuss the week in sport including the start of the Rugby League World Cup, the Second Cricket Test between South Africa and Australia, the Wallabies host the All Blacks, plus A-League Men and AFLW.

abcsydney.au.title: The World This Week
abcsydney.au.description: E39 Sunday 18 October 2026 Girish Sawlani brings you a weekly roundup of international news from an Australian perspective as reported by ABC News correspondents covering the Indo Pacific, Europe, North America, the Middle East, India and Indonesia.

abcsydney.au.title: Compass
abcsydney.au.description: S40 E8 Yaluu (See You Again) A descendant of First Nations WWI soldier William Allan Irwin sets out on an emotional journey to France, where he seeks to honour his ancestor and return his spirit home to Gomeroi country. A Compass Anzac Day special.

actionmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. - 2006

actionmax.us.description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. - 2022
