showtimewomen.us.description: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent. - 2006

showtimewomen.us.title: Frida
showtimewomen.us.description: Mexican painter Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) marries fellow artist Diego Rivera who shares her radical political views. - 2002

showtimewomen.us.title: Alone in Berlin
showtimewomen.us.description: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi. - 2016

showtimewomen.us.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
showtimewomen.us.description: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination. - 2003

showtimewomen.us.title: You've Got Mail
showtimewomen.us.description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. - 1998

showtimewomen.us.title: An Unfinished Life
showtimewomen.us.description: Old wounds get a chance to heal when a Wyoming rancher (Robert Redford) shelters his abused daughter-in-law (Jennifer Lopez) and her child. - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
showtimewomen.us.description: Befuddled mom-to-be Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) must figure out which of the two men (Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey) in her life is the father of her child. - 2016

showtimewomen.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimewomen.us.description: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them. - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: The Devil Inside
showtimewomen.us.description: A woman (Fernanda Andrade) recruits two young exorcists to help her determine whether her mother, who murdered three people, is mentally ill or possessed by demons. - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: The Woman in Black
showtimewomen.us.description: A widowed lawyer (Daniel Radcliffe) encounters ghostly goings-on at the foreboding estate of a recently deceased client. - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: Paranormal Activity
showtimewomen.us.description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night. - 2007

showtimewomen.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
showtimewomen.us.description: After experiencing what they think are break-ins, a family realizes that the events unfolding before them are more sinister than they seem. - 2010

showtimewomen.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
showtimewomen.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

showtimewomen.us.title: Paranormal Activity 4
showtimewomen.us.description: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: Blindness
showtimewomen.us.description: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. (Thriller, Drama) - 2008

showtimewomen.us.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
showtimewomen.us.description: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

showtimewomen.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimewomen.us.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Chocolat
showtimewomen.us.description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. (Drama, Romance) - 2000

showtimewomen.us.title: Mean Girls
showtimewomen.us.description: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. (Comedy) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: Body Cam
showtimewomen.us.description: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

showtimewomen.us.title: The Ring Two
showtimewomen.us.description: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: The Uninvited
showtimewomen.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
showtimewomen.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: Fatal Attraction
showtimewomen.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

showtimewomen.us.title: A Perfect Murder
showtimewomen.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Cop Land
themoviechannel.us.description: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Million Dollar Baby
themoviechannel.us.description: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. (Drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
themoviechannel.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Top Gun
themoviechannel.us.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 1986

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal
themoviechannel.us.description: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? (Comedy drama) - 2004

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Gillespie's New Assistant
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The hospital superiors order aging Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) to hire an assistant, so the old physician reluctantly agrees to choose between upstarts Dr. Adams (Van Johnson), Dr. Lee Wong How (Keye Luke) and Dr. Lindsey (Richard Quine). Instead of testing their scientific smarts, Gillespie decides to show the young men that medical school alone cannot make someone into a good caregiver. Eventually, the three hopefuls realize they should take the elderly doctor's advice to heart. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - Hyde and Go Tweet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sylvester chases Tweety as he flies outside the office of Dr. Jekyll; Tweety ends up in the Hyde formula, transforming him into a giant. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1960-05-14

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - Dr. Jerkyl's Hide
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sylvester Cat gets chased into Dr. Jekyll's lab by a pair of canines. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1954-05-08

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Barkleys of Broadway
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Josh (Fred Astaire) and Dinah Barkley (Ginger Rogers) are a famous musical theater duo, but an argument on the opening night of their newest Broadway show reveals previously unspoken resentments. Dinah feels overshadowed by Josh, so when flirtatious playwright Jacques Pierre Barredout (Jacques François) suggests she play the lead in his new drama about Sarah Bernhardt, she separates from Josh and endeavors to become a serious actress. Can producer Ezra Miller (Oscar Levant) reunite the duo? (Musical) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lured
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sandra Carpenter (Lucille Ball) is a London-based dancer who is distraught to learn that her friend has disappeared. Soon after the disappearance, she's approached by Harley Temple (Charles Coburn), a police investigator who believes her friend has been murdered by a serial killer who uses personal ads to find his victims. Temple hatches a plan to catch the killer using Sandra as bait, and Sandra agrees to help. But complications arise when Sandra becomes engaged to a nightclub owner. (Thriller) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (Spencer Tracy) experiments with human nature, believing that each person has both good and evil sides that can be brought forth chemically. Jekyll tests a serum on himself, releasing his vicious alter ego, Mr. Hyde, on 19th-century London. Prowling the town, Hyde ventures to a music hall and encounters Ivy (Ingrid Bergman), whom he takes forcibly as his mistress. When the serum's effects wear off, Jekyll vows never to take it again. But Hyde is not gone for good. (Horror) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Soylent Green
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In a densely overpopulated, starving New York City of the future, NYPD detective Robert Thorn investigates the murder of an executive at rations manufacturer Soylent Corporation. With the help of elderly academic Solomon "Sol" Roth, Thorn begins to make real progress -- until the governor mysteriously pulls the plug. Obsessed with the mystery, Thorn steps out from behind the badge and launches his own investigation into the murder. (Science fiction, Mystery) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Rear Window
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A newspaper photographer with a broken leg passes time recuperating by observing his neighbors through his window. He sees what he believes to be a murder, and decides to solve the crime himself. With the help of his nurse and wife, he tries to catch the murderer without being killed himself. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1954

wbtv.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. wfrv.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

wfrv.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ

wfrv.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ

"Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. wfrv.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris

wfrv.us.title: Into the Outdoors

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E10 The Winter Vegetable Patch Winter is always a tough time for the garden but makes cold weather crops more valuable. Some recipes include - orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and a cabbage salad with dressing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Rising In Adversity Audrey Chew is the founder of You Tiao Man, which brings the humble hawker fried dough stick youtiao to the wider manufacturing stage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Menu Two Chicken is the focus, and Mark has some techniques to share. Some recipes include, a chicken bacon broccoli crumble and a Thai-inspired green curry. Mark shows us how to break down a whole chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Easy Entertaining The show is brimming with recipes that are perfect for a whole host of occasions from an impromptu dinner with friends to fresh and fun party food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 The New Age Hawkers Paul and Yu Jie are a young couple who founded Craft'B, which serves up modern rice bowls in Singapore's Central Business District.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Clifton Mamid: Tempura Fish & Blachung With Asian Style Salad Clifton Mamid is a trained chef who draws on his grandfather's Malaysian influence and whips up three separate dishes that make for a scrumptious meal.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Best In Season Maggie searches for the perfect tomato which she then uses to make a tomato bruschetta. Simon, not to be outdone, makes his own version of bruschetta using pear and goats cheese.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E15 Episode 15 Vegan Liz Douglas teaches Laura her healthy Chocolate Chia Mousse.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Artichokes Two Ways Rachael honors her beloved grandfather by making his recipe for stuffed artichokes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E9 Townsville Just off Townsville is the famous Magnetic Island which is Hayden's destination, but first he heads out to meet a young sweet potato farmer, and pick up some pineapples.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Episode 5 Dan Pasquali's brings a bit of flair to his crispy, nutty Pistachio Cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E10 Episode 10 of Season 9 Laura Sharrad cooks Singaporean laksa in the Prahran Markets; Chef Masa from Asian Inspirations joins Laura and cooks beef curry udon; Catherine Velisha makes baked fennel salad; Laura prepares fridge clean-out frittata from hydrogen home kitchen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Episode 8 Rick and Chalky travel to Loch Torridon in Scotland to go fishing with John McGreggor for langoustines. Here the prawns are protected by the Marien Stewardship Council.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E39 Episode 39 Keep the kids happy with Justine's Kid's Sticky Chicken Rice Bowls and Fillo Sausage Rolls recipe. Later, Guest Silvia Colloca joins Justine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E72 Lazy Braise Chef Ella Mittas and comedian Jean Kittson are taking a load off, as they join Adam in celebration of luscious, lazy braises.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Beyond Bali With Lara Lee
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Flores: The Maritime Splendour Of Komodo & Beyond Arriving at the vibrant port of Labuan Bajo, in Flores, Lara Lee sets sail through the waters of the Komodo National Park to explore how the ocean shapes identity, cuisine and connection to Indonesia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: How Do They Really Do It?
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 KFC: How Do They Really Do It? KFC is one of the biggest fast-food chains on the planet. Go inside the kitchens and behind the scenes of this fried chicken empire, see how the food is cooked and explore how they really do it.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Amalul's Pandan Bubble Tea Amalul, Alimah's granddaughter, is a self-proclaimed bubble tea connoisseur. She shares her bright bubble tea brew and pays tribute to the vibrant and flavourful pandanus leaf.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A New Zealand Food Story
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Episode 5 Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Nuggets, Noodles And Nose-To-Tail David travels to Syracuse to a trendy spot that serves fresh fish straight from the market, visits a chef who brings her Michelin star cooking to the streets of a small town in Puglia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 End Of An Era With the new $800 million Sydney Fish Market just six days from opening, buyers and merchants are given their first detailed look inside-and not everyone likes what they see.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein: From Venice To

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 The Cliffs Of Ireland Bathing sheep and scaling cliffs for crab, Gordon traverses land and sea in search of the culinary wonders of Ireland's stunning Connemara Coast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Costa Del Sol In The Costa Del Sol, James is shown how paella is made and visits the lost village El Acebuchal. He goes to a citrus farm and learns how muscatel ice cream is made, then cooks Andalusian rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Cordoba James tours Cordoba on an eco tuk tuk as he visits a food market, eats oxtail at a Michelin-starred restaurant, helps judge a salmorejo competition and sees how pastel Cordobes is made.

Merlin feels the weight of his destiny like never before as the ancient prophecies play out with terrifying accuracy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E18 Time to Get Ill When Jessica tries to sleep off a bad flu, Louis and the boys splurge on a pricey pay-per-view wrestling match that she would never allow. But they are shocked to learn that she was secretly having some fun of her own.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E19 Driving Miss Jenny Louis worries that Grandma's new motorised wheelchair gives her too much freedom, so he makes it a point to keep a close eye on her. Meanwhile, Jessica fears that Emery's sentimental ways have turned him into a hoarder.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E6 Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones While Missy asks some uncomfortable questions about sex in church, Meemaw and Georgie go into business together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mr. Bean ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E14 Bean Bug Mr. Bean becomes Mrs. Wicket's house-mate when he suffers a flea infestation. Will they get on?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mr. Bean
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 Bean Phone Mr Bean wants a smart phone but they're too expensive especially when you can build your own!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mr. Bean
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Hotel Bean Mr Bean has some unexpected guests who think he runs a hotel!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E55 BTN High breaks down the week's biggest news stories for Aussie high schoolers.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E2 Love at First Flight Our heroes discover a love story between two Trainers who star with their Pokemon in a local dance festival.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Goku, Surpass Super Saiyan God! Goku continues to surprise Beerus with his growing powers. As their fight escalates, the universe manages to stay intact, but for how long? Then, Goku reverts back to a Super Saiyan! Have his godly powers run out?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E6 Silencer Ladybug and Cat Noir face Luka, akumatized into Silencer. Ready to raise your voices?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 The Price Of Advice After a paper origami fortune teller tells Izzy she's the world's best advice giver, she's determined to prove it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E49 Life of Pie When Izzy, Jude and Owen accidentally bring a pizza to life, they do everything they can to help him find a new purpose in life other than being eaten.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E34 Daycare of Rock After believing he's turned Chef to stone, Duncan sets his sights on ultimate chaos only to discover there's no joy in victory without an adversary.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E18 Small World: Stone Cold Spider With Townsville in peril, the girls are sent to the Arctic on a dangerous mission to find the key to saving the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E28 Where Exactly On the Globe is Carl Sanpedro Pt. 4 In the final epic showdown with Carl Sanpedro, the Titans head to Croatia - the home of dragons and ice zombies.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E5 Staggering Storytellers Spanning 3,000 years of recorded history, we look at how some of our finest writers cured their writing block. We see the development of storytelling technology and learn how Charles Dickens was the Harry Styles of his day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 The Ghost Darrell and Sally are determined to solve the mystery of the Malory ghost, but discover the truth is far more complex than they could ever have imagined.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 The Case Of The Vanishing Koalas Kakow Koalas are the latest snack sensation sweeping the playground and Mario is hungry for justice when his are stolen.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E7 Hoof Fashion Shaun accidentally becomes a trendsetter but soon discovers that fashion is fickle and is forced to ever more outrageous lengths to stay ahead of on trend.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E75 Orchid's Almost Half Hour Talent Show All the agents want to be a part of Orchid's talent show.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: ABC Kids Programs Resume At 4am
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teletubbies
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Wait For It The Teletubbies wait for Tubby Toast, then they wait for the Tubby Phone to be answered and finally they wait to see the Tiddlytubbies go to Sleepybyes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ariel: Mermaid Tales (Shorts)
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E70 Ariel's Tall Mer-tale/ Remy The Houseguest Ariel tells a tall mer-tale. Ariel has a houseguest.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E26 Daniel's Important Job at the Market: Daniel's Important Job at the Enchanted Daniel is excited to plant flowers at the Enchanted Garden, so he is bummed to find out that his job is pulling out weeds. Mom explains that the others can't do their jobs until Daniel does his - his job is important too!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie & Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E40 Sunflowers Maddie is upset when she discovers that her sunflower has not grown as tall as everyone else's; what could possibly be holding back this little flower from saying yes?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Spies Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf compete to build a boat that will beat the Marigolds'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E46 Finders Keepers The Jedi help a scrapper repair her droid.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E18 The Jolly Ninjalino Pirate Robot seeks help when Night Ninja steals his hat. When Pirate Robot is left out of the PJs plans, he tries to help anyway and only makes the situation much worse!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Jungle Ghost While setting up Tweak's latest tech to track creatures in the Congolese Jungle, Tracker, Kwazii, and Tweak stumble upon a young creature that appears to be missing from the Creature Collection.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 No Power, No Problem! When the power goes out all over Sodor, Thomas and Friends must use brainpower to navigate the island in creative new ways.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E24 Four on the Floor Four and friends bust some big moves on the dance floor with the Four Times Table. Learn the four times table with the Numberblocks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Puppy party Pants worries that having adoptive bunny parents might not make him puppy enough for a puppy party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fantus And The Animals
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Fantus and the Pigs Fantus meets a pig sow and piglets. The pigs shower, dig in the mud and eat.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E46 The Blackberry Bush Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E10 Dorothy's Un-rosy Tea Captain, Lucia, and Dorothy host a rosy tea party. After singing 'Captain Put the Kettle On,' they realise Dorothy's tea is missing something. Captain calls Earl and Grey, the tea specialists, for a solution!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E8 The Rabbit The Farmer's niece has come to visit, bringing her pet rabbit. When the rabbit disappears Shaun and the Flock are called to action to help track down the illusive pet before the niece discovers it's missing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Spider Monkey Rhino steals a Spider Monkey from the zoo, and it's up to Spidey and Ghost-Spider to bring him home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Trouble Bubbles Supertato and Evil Pea get stuck inside a giant bubble together. They float through the air until Supertato and Evil Pea pop the bubble by driving it into a supermarket sign.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E74 Vanishing Valentines / Golden Gift Mr. Puppypaws uses his glitter dragon to steal Valentine's Day cards. / When Ginny accidentally breaks a special gift of friendship that Bitsy gave her, she tries to hide the truth.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Elf School Holly and Nanny Plum join Ben at Elf School, where the Wise Old Elf tells them that strictly no magic should be used. All the Elf children are very good at building their toys.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Por Por Day Flower can't wait for Por Por Day, expecting a lazy day of treats, but she's surprised when her grandmother reveals she has a packed schedule planned!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 Flour's Fun List Flower writes a Pet Day 'fun list' for Flour, but quickly discovers that letting him choose his own fun is way better than sticking to a list.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E32 Clubhouse Adventure Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse. Together the children create adventure stories about wild animals, and they let the parents play too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E33 Talking There is a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking, everyone loves talking!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E50 Surprise Bluey and Bingo want Dad to play two different games, so Dad plays both at the same time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 Perfect Bluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect but she can't decide what to draw! So Mum reminds her about all the fun times she's had with Dad and how he's not so perfect either.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Pea-Rex Pinball Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes discover a new game - Pea-Rex Pinball! It's all fun and games until they suddenly find themselves cornered by a horde of super irritated Vegesaurs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Lost Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes search for honeysuckles, leaving behind a trail of berries to help find their way back. But when Wasabi eats the trail, they're stranded in the dark!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Tick Tick Boom Boom is showing off but slips and has a mild panic. To hide his embarrassment he challenges Zog to a Dragon Off! Zog must set aside his desire to win and help his rival.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 The Acorn Badge Norrie is upset when she sees a leaf fall from the tree, because she thinks it's broken.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Hey Quacky! Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club today. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors and nurses.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E22 Poo Crew News The Episode The Poo Crew News Team are back in their very own episode! First order of business? Farm poo. Join Kiki, Koko and Miki on a deep dive investigation into animal poo and how it can be used for good!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E4 Sea And Space: 4 Join Matt and Alex as they experiment with making craters, go on an eventful journey in a cardboard box submarine and tell an entertaining story about Miss Octopus! Through The Windows we discover some amazing sea life.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Captain Keith Keith dreams of a pirate adventure. The Piggies build a wheeled ship and sail across Fine Forest for treasure. But Wilf plans to steal it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Sky Pirates Pt 2 Annoyed at being stopped, the jesters steal the crystal which keeps the sky land afloat. Our crew go after it but get separated during their mission.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Super Monsters: Vida's First Halloween Vida discovers the magic of Halloween and Dia de los Muertos with the Super Monsters, learning to embrace new traditions with courage and joy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Yip Yip Book Book It's the Pretty Big All City Read, but all of the books go missing! The Mechas need to find them and fast!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Nikhil and Jay and the Butterflies When Nikhil sets out on a mission to spot butterflies, he's determined to do it alone. Will Jay's butterfly fairy magic get in the way or help Nikhil after all?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 The Most Magnificent Rainbow When Miles misses out on seeing a beautiful rainbow, Millie tries to recreate one for her little brother, in her very own home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 The Wizard's Whistle Melanie won't go to her favourite beach because of a strange sound known as The Wizard's Whistle! Is it a bird? Is it a kettle? Stan and Gran investigate!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Miffy And Bun Make Art Miffy is excited to make her first artwork from clay, but when Baby Bun wants to make something with her, Miffy is worried that he will ruin it.

BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E7 Paradise Towers: Part 3 Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots while the Doctor and the surviving Kangs learn all about Kroagnon the Great Architect.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E5 The Happiness Patrol: Part 1 The Happiness Patrol walk the streets of Terra Alpha, destroying all the killjoys, on the orders of the despotic Helen A. And in the Kandy Kitchen, something terrible lurks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E8 Silver Nemesis: Part 1 A group of Neo-Nazis in South America are seeking the Nemesis Statue – as is a shuttle full of Cybermen and the mysterious Lady Peinforte from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E9 Silver Nemesis: Part 2 The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back because they were prepared with gold-tipped arrows and De Flores still has a plan to set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E10 Silver Nemesis: Part 3 The Nemesis Statue is alive, thanks to Lady Peinforte's insanity, and with De Flores's Nazi’s wiped out by the Cybermen, Nemesis claims it has secrets to reveal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E11 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 1 Bellboy and Flowerchild escape the Psychic Circus but are pursued by the Chief Clown. The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to Segonax, some of whom are not what they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E12 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 2 The mysterious family watching the acts within the ring, dissatisfied with Nord, destroy him. Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he’s not the next to displease them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E1 Battlefield: Part 1 As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive to contine waging a war that began thousands of years ago, but in a wholly different dimension.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E2 Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

koam.us.title: Dr. Chris: Pet Vet
koam.us.description: Busy veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown encounters many adventures in the day-to-day of a life dedicated to caring for and treating animals. koam.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
koam.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. koam.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
koam.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

koam.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ

This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wecpld.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

wecpld.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ

This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wecpld.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ
wecpld.us.description: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children. (Reality, Nature, Animals, Educational) - 2018-09-29

"Dr. Chris: Pet Vet" features the animal and human interest stories he and his friend and colleague Dr. Lisa Chimes -- whom he calls on for animals that require specialist services -- run into as they deal with a variety of animals who undergo an assortment of different treatments, including some of the most intricate and technologically advanced surgeries available. (Reality, Animals, Pets) - 2013-09-28

wecpld.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
wecpld.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. Now, the festival lends its famous name to this hidden-camera prank show starring a Quebec-based troupe. Canada is the stage and its inhabitants are the characters -- some might say victims -- for the "Candid Camera"-style pranks featured on the half-hour series. Although the pranks last just a few minutes each, that's just long enough to inflict embarrassment on the subjects of the pranks. (Comedy, Reality) - 2015-08-31

whp.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
whp.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. whp.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ

This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wncn.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. wwaydt2.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
wwaydt2.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wwaydt2.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ

"Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. wwaydt2.us.title: Dr. Chris: Pet Vet

wwaydt2.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris

wymtdt.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. fxm.us.description: In this classic Western, wanderers Gil Carter (Henry Fonda) and Art Croft (Henry Morgan) ride into a small Nevada town plagued by cattle thieves. Initially suspected of being the rustlers themselves, Carter and Croft eventually join a posse out to get the criminals, who also may be involved in a recent shooting. When the posse closes in on a group that could be the fugitives, they must decide on a course of action, with numerous lives hanging in the balance. (Western) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Hombre
fxm.us.description: John Russell finds that the world is not so welcoming when he returns to his Arizona hometown to collect his inheritance. A white man raised by American Indians, Russell is subjected to numerous instances of racism when people discover his background. When the stagecoach Russell is riding in is held up by a gang run by one of the scheming passengers, Cicero Grimes, it falls to Russell to defend the passengers -- the very people who have dismissed and insulted him. (Western) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Bandolero!
fxm.us.description: There is little hope for bandit Dee Bishop (Dean Martin) and his gang as they wait to be hanged. But at the last second, the hangman -- Dee's brother, Mace (James Stewart), in disguise -- helps them escape. After kidnapping a rancher's wife (Raquel Welch) and with the vengeful sheriff (George Kennedy) in pursuit, they retreat to an abandoned town. Tired of their desperado life, the brothers consider going straight. But when a gang of bandoleros attacks, their chances at starting over seem dim. (Western, Drama) - 1968

fxm.us.title: 100 Rifles
fxm.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

fxm.us.title: Moulin Rouge
fxm.us.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 2001

axstv.us.title: Quigley Down Under
axstv.us.description: Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. When Quigley meets his employer, Elliott Marston (Alan Rickman), he's appalled to discover the job involves killing Aboriginal Australians. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge. (Western) - 1990

cinevault.us.title: Money Train
cinevault.us.description: Charlie (Woody Harrelson) is a New York City transit cop with a mountain of gambling debts, and John (Wesley Snipes) is his responsible, and frequently exasperated, foster brother. They compete amicably for the affections of fellow officer Grace (Jennifer Lopez), but things become more serious when Charlie decides to rob the "money train" that carries the Transit Authority's daily proceeds. John must decide whether to prevent Charlie's crime or to join in on the heist. (Action, Movie) - 1995

cinevault.us.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
cinevault.us.description: New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite. (Comedy, Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2009-12-18

cinevault.us.title: Bewitched
cinevault.us.description: Movie star Jack Wyatt (Will Ferrell) has hit a rough patch in his career. Looking to make a comeback, he signs on to play the role of Darrin in a movie version of the popular 1960s sitcom "Bewitched." Jack insists that an unknown is hired to play Darrin's better half, the beguiling witch-housewife Samantha, so the studio finds an up-and-comer named Isabel Bigelow (Nicole Kidman). Once shooting begins, though, Jack learns that Isabel was cast too well -- since she actually is a witch. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2005-06-24

cinevault.us.title: Swept From the Sea
cinevault.us.description: Amy (Rachel Weisz), a maid in the house of wealthy Miss Swaffer (Kathy Bates), falls for a Russian stranger named Yanko (Vincent Perez) after his boat mistakenly washes up in the seaside village where she lives. Despite the villagers' wariness of Yanko, Amy cultivates a relationship with him, while Miss Swaffer's doctor, James (Ian McKellen), teaches him English. When Amy marries Yanko, despite the objections of James -- who secretly pines for the sailor -- tragedy lurks around the corner. (Movie, Romance) - 1997

cinevault.us.title: Breakout

cinevault.us.title: Birdy
cinevault.us.description: Birdy returns from the Vietnam War scarred from the horrific experiences of battle. He is so damaged by what he saw that he has shut himself off from reality completely, imagining that he is actually a bird. Birdy is confined to a mental hospital, where the doctors are at a loss as to how to treat him. In an attempt to help, Al, his best friend from high school -- and who was also in Vietnam -- visits him every day to try and get through to him. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-12-14

cinevault.us.title: The Shadow Riders
cinevault.us.description: Mac Traven (Tom Selleck) is a Civil War veteran who fought for the North, while his brother, Dal (Sam Elliott), was allied with the South. In spite of this considerable point of contention, the siblings must work together when they find that other family members have been abducted, along with Dal's girlfriend, Kate (Katharine Ross). Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives. (Movie, Western) - 1982-09-28

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Bengaluru vs. Chennai - Day 1 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E2 It's the "Southern Derby" in the World Pickleball League (WPL) as Bengaluru takes on Chennai in the second tie of the day, live from the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai. The match features 48 players from six teams and 14 countries, with commentators detailing every crucial point.The tie begins with a thrilling Men's Singles match: Bengaluru's Blaskowitz (a Croatian talent) faces Chennai's Sobek (the Polish national champion). The commentators highlight the extreme patience and dinking skills demonstrated by both players, with Sobek's ability to keep the ball low being a key factor.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Hyderabad vs. Chennai - Day 8 Tie 1 + Bollywood Exhibition Match
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E20 The high-voltage group stage of the World Pickleball League (WPL) nears its end on Day 8 with a crucial tie between the Hyderabad Superstars and the Chennai Super Champs. The commentary team sets the stage for a tense match, which is determined by an incredibly close final scoreline and points difference, with all six teams still in the running for the four semi-final spots. Also witness the Exhibition Match of the Century featuring Bollywood superstars Aamir Ali (Team Aamir) and Ali Fazal (Team Ali), live from the CCI Brabourne Stadium.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Mixed Split Pro Age - Whitewell/Kawka vs. Schull/Endara
pickletv.us.description: S1 E17 Experience the excitement of the Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match on Championship Court. This video features a unique pairing of new partners Schull and Endara, who are familiar with the heat and come from a grinding three-game win in their last match. They face off against the formidable Lee Whitwell and Kafka. With Lee Whitwell's impressive hands and athleticism, and Kafka's hard-hitting forehand and topspin drives, this is a matchup you won't want to miss. Get ready for incredible rallies and a display of top-tier pickleball as these pros battle it out.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Utah Regional 2025 - Utah Valley vs. Utah Tech
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E10 The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : US Open 2023 – Women’s Senior Pro Doubles Semifinal – Bagby & Bellamy vs Dawson & Williams
pickletv.us.description: S1 E34 Catch all the action from the Women's Senior Pro Doubles Semifinal 1 at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships held in Naples, Florida. This semifinal match features top senior pros Nathalie Bagby and Beth Bellamy facing Jennifer Dawson and Bonnie Williams in a high-stakes contest. Expert commentary highlights key strategies, player strengths, and match dynamics including powerful serves from Ava Welsher, tactical lobs, and intense court positioning. Follow how the players adjust to crowd pressure and timeouts in this best-of-three game format. Get ready for a thrilling showdown in one of pickleball’s premier senior pro events.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : US Open 2024 – Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal – Courter & Humberg vs Frantova & Karges

With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

pickletv.us.description: S1 E9 Catch the exhilarating Men's Pro Doubles match from the 2025 Minto US Open Pickleball Championships, powered by Margaritaville! Witness incredible action on the Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida, the paradise coast for pickleball. This thrilling match features the dynamic duo of John Cangelosi and Michael Leonard against their formidable opponents. Get ready for intense rallies, powerful shots, and strategic play from top professional pickleball players. Don't miss this must-watch event from the epicenter of pickleball!

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UCLA vs. SDSU
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E15 Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - University of South Florida vs. Kansas Jayhawks
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E8 The intensity reaches a boiling point in Saint Louis as the NCPA Nationals transition to a high-stakes, single-elimination "win or go home" format. The University of South Florida Bulls and the Kansas Jayhawks take center stage in a best-of-seven battle where every point feels like a "Racing" sprint toward the championship crown. Watch as Austin King and Tessa Wilson utilize elite "Skills" to navigate a narrow center court, fending off a late-game surge by the Jayhawks to secure a hard-fought 11-8 victory. With the bracket tightening and powerhouses like Penn State and Michigan looming, this "Freestyle" display of collegiate talent proves that in the world of elite pickleball, there is zero room for error.

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - The Eagle Scout

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Crime Stories - The Teenage Terrors
truecrimenetwork.us.description: School rumors and wiretaps lead police to three teenagers guilty of the murder of a local DJ and security guard with a fondness for helping wayward youths. (Science, Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Obsession: Dark Desires - Final Fantasy

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Murder Comes to Town - The Devil Wears Sneakers
truecrimenetwork.us.description: A family of five is found beaten to death in their home in the tight-knit farming community of Beason, Ill. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - Murder on the Gulf Coast
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When the body of former police officer Taylor Wright is discovered buried on a remote Florida farm, detectives have a lineup of suspects to investigate including her ex-husband, her new live-in girlfriend, and her best friend. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - Murder in the Kentucky Hills
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Shayna Hubers calls 911 to report she has killed her boyfriend in self-defense; however, investigators soon learn he was planning a date with another woman and suspect Shayna killed him in a jealous rage. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The New Detectives - Living in Terror

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Finally Caught - Dabate

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Heartland Homicide - Summer Inman

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Crime Stories - The Long-Stemmed Killer

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The New Detectives - Electronic Witness

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Gone in 60 Days
speedvision.us.description: Work ramps up on the 1970 Tribute Superbird; Mark begins work on a new project, a 1968 Plymouth GTX owned by "Overhaulin'" host Chris Jacobs.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mopardy
speedvision.us.description: Stress levels rise in the shop when Mark learns that the owner of Tony's Mopar Parts will be arriving to check on the progress of his 1970 Dodge Challenger; Mark distracts Tony while the team hustles to begin the vehicle's restoration.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - A Buck Shorted
speedvision.us.description: As SEMA 2017 fast approaches, the Graveyard Ghouls work hard on Chris Jacobs' 1969 Plymouth GTX and John Buck's 1971 Dodge Challenger with a Hellcrate Hemi; Mark wonders if he will be able to keep his promises as the pressure begins to mount.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - The Phoenix Cuda
speedvision.us.description: A legendary Mopar that was incinerated rises from the ashes.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - SEMA Has Eyes on a Hellbird
speedvision.us.description: Concluding the epic builds of Chris Jacob's 1968 GTX after it suffered a devastating fire; finishing the first of its kind 1970 Plymouth Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - '68 GTX vs. Echo Bomber
speedvision.us.description: With SEMA in their rearview mirror, the ghouls begin the final assembly of a 1969 Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise; when help comes up short-handed, Mark enlists what he likes to call his Echo Bomber.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Pilot Takes Flight
speedvision.us.description: Mark and Royal watch the never-before-aired pilot featuring some of the first Mopar restorations the original Ghouls tackled more than 10 years ago.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Surveying the Will to Work
speedvision.us.description: Dave jumps from car to car during a hectic day, installing and assembling what he can; Will struggles to keep focused on one project at a time; Mark makes progress on his A100 build with the hopes of revealing at SEMA 2018.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - What's Next?
speedvision.us.description: Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard; he brings the ghouls two brand-new projects, one of which includes installing a brand-new car.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Performance With a Touch of Luxury
speedvision.us.description: The Ghouls say goodbye to the 1970 Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi by taking it out for one last drive; it's all hands on deck to get the beautiful second-generation Plymouth GTX finished in time for the big reveal for the owner.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Dissecting a Daytona
speedvision.us.description: With a Plymouth GTX finished, the ghouls refocus their efforts on the 1970 Dodge Daytona; Mark and Tony had debated whether they should restore it or not; with the owner wanting a full restoration, the Ghouls begin the tedious disassembly.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Getting Blitzed at London's Café de Paris
truehistory.us.description: An evening in March 1941, when the Café de Paris is destroyed in the Blitz; the history of the café; how its destruction reflects the horrors of wartime London; the resiliency of the citizens who keep calm and carry on under the threat of war.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - On Carnaby Street during the Swinging '60s
truehistory.us.description: Carnaby Street emerges in the 17th century; a symbol of social change in the 1960s; its history; it becomes a magnet for trendsetters and youth culture in post-war London; why these changes are embraced by some and seen as a threat by others.

truehistory.us.title: In the Footsteps of Van Gogh - The World of Vincent Van Gogh
truehistory.us.description: Tying together several facts about Van Gogh's life.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Napoleon III's Paris
truehistory.us.description: Napoleon III declares himself emperor of France in 1853; his aim is to modernize the economy of France, create a sophisticated rail-transport system and completely rebuild Paris; this means that, for most Parisians, life is utterly disrupted.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Baudelaire and the Definition of Modernism
truehistory.us.description: A poet and art critic named Charles Baudelaire begins writing systematically about art in 1846; his basic idea is that art should be "of its own times"; he struggles to find artists who will embody his ideals.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - The Shock of the New
truehistory.us.description: Edouard Manet is among the best-educated and most authoritatively independent artists of the 19th century; he paints works that transcend Baudelaire; Manet's painting is as great as Baudelaire's poetry and greater than his art criticism.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Understanding Culture through Cooking
truehistory.us.description: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Ancient Rome: Cooking with Apicius
truehistory.us.description: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Imperial China: Soybeans and Dumplings
truehistory.us.description: Examining the Chinese Wei dynasty's "Qi Min Yao Shu"; learning about Chinese agricultural practices going back to antiquity; the fermentation practices of the time; following a scaled-down recipe to create a fermented black bean dish.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Medieval Egypt: Chickpeas and Phyllo Dough
truehistory.us.description: Exploring recipes from 14th-century Egypt that reflect the interchange between the many cultures of the Eastern Mediterranean of the time; learning to make himmas kassa and a light and flaky phyllo dough stretched to the size of a table.

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - The Origins of Modern Archaeology
truehistory.us.description: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Excavating Pompeii and Herculaneum
truehistory.us.description: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Schliemann and His Successors at Troy
truehistory.us.description: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Early Archaeology in Mesopotamia
truehistory.us.description: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Oscar Wilde's Decadent London
truehistory.us.description: London when it is home to Oscar Wilde at the close of the 19th century; the details of Wilde's trial for indecency; the way London society is structured; how immense wealth and privilege, for some, leaves its imprint on the city and its history.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - St. Paul's Cathedral in Faith, Fire, and Sin
truehistory.us.description: St. Paul's Cathedral has overlooked London from a high point in the city for generations; the history of this church that has been much more than a place of worship; it has survived fire and the ravages of war; episodes from the cathedral's past.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Exploring unique and unusual hotels in Uruguay, Sweden, Scotland, Oman and the Netherlands; a camouflaged fort-like resort perched on the edge of a mountain.
