tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E11 Property Brothers: Leslie & Tim Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E12 Property Brothers: Kyle & Jackie Kyle and Jackie are living at her mom's until they find a home of their own. And though they've got a healthy budget, they've set their sights on one of the city's priciest neighborhoods.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E14 Property Brothers: Emily & Ken With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E03 Property Brothers: Monique and Carl Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E09 Property Brothers: Mark & Eugenie Juggling after-school activities with their careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had time for house hunting. While the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, the Property Brothers warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E10 Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. classica.us.title: Franz in Wien: Mozart und Schönberg
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst leitet sein Cleveland Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Divertimento Nr. 2 in D-Dur, KV 131, und Arnold Schönbergs Variationen für Orchester, Op. 31, aufgenommen in der Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA.

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda.

classica.us.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
classica.us.description: Stefano Demicheli dirigiert das Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici und die Solisten Nicola Cianncio und Catherine Jones in einem abwechslungsreichen Programm aus Barockmusik, aufgenommen in der Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Siena in Neapel, Italien.

classica.us.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
classica.us.description: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in dieser Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll. Die Solisten sind Christiane Karg, Sara Mingardo, Matthew Swensen und Gianluca Buratto.

classica.us.title: Bach - 5. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 5 in D-Dur, BWV 1050. Das Cembalo tritt zusammen mit Flöte und Geige in diesem Konzert als Solist auf.

classica.us.title: Händel, Der Messias
classica.us.description: Aus dem Theater an der Wien: das Oratorium "Der Messias" von Georg Friedrich Händel (1685-1759) in szenischer Form. Musikalische Leitung: Jean-Christophe Spinosi - Inszenierung: Claus Guth. Mit Susan Gritton, Bejun Mehta, Richard Croft.

classica.us.title: Chopin - Introduktion und Polonaise, Op. 3
classica.us.description: Die Cellistin Silvia Chiesa und der Pianist Maurizio Baglini spielen Frédéric Chopins Introduction und Polonaise brillante in C-Dur, Op. 3. Das Konzert wurde 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Patmos - Ein musikalischer Dokumentarfilm
classica.us.description: Jeden Sommer findet auf der griechischen Insel Patmos das Patmos Musikfestival statt, ein einzigartiges musikalisches Ereignis, das sowohl ein Kammer- als auch ein Sakralmusikfestival umfasst. Dieser Film begleitet die Ausgabe von 2024.

classica.us.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in f-Moll, op. 49
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni führt Frédéric Chopins Fantaisie in f-Moll, Op. 49, auf. Molteni begann im Alter von sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er absolvierte das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung.

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees.

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 4 BWV 1017
classica.us.description: Zu hören ist die Sonate für Violine und Cembalo Nr. 4, BWV 1017 von Johann Sebastian Bach.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert.

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Haydn, Tschaikowski und anderen
classica.us.description: Dieses Kammermusikkonzert ist Teil der Konzertreihe Präludium der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía in Madrid. Das Programm beginnt mit Joseph Haydns Konzert in D-Dur für Violoncello und Orchester, H VIIb: 2, aufgeführt von Pareja und Chavaldas.

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Präludien und Fugen
classica.us.description: Die 24 Präludien und Fugen, op. 87 von Dmitri Schostakowitsch dienten als Inspiration für dieses Projekt von Simona Bucci. Sieben Tänzer der „Compagnia Simona Bucci" treten zu den Präludien und Fugen Nr. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 und 24 auf.

classica.us.title: Fantasymphony - Ein Konzert voller Feuer und Magie
classica.us.description: Der Publikumshit Fantasymphony ist zurück. Diesmal gibt es epische Musik aus den größten Fantasy-Filmen, -Serien und -Spielen. Das Dänische Nationale Symphonie-Orchester öffnet die Tore zu den magischen Welten aus der Herr der Ringe und mehr.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Der Karneval der Tiere
classica.us.description: Der mexikanische Dirigent Carlos Miguel Prieto leitet die Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in einer Aufführung der Suite "Der Karneval der Tiere" von Camille Saint-Saëns. Sie besteht aus 14 Sätzen, von denen jeder ein anderes Tier darstellt.

classica.us.title: Sheherezade
classica.us.description: Diese Version von "Sheherezade" von Jean-Christophe Maillot ist ein Tribut an die Ballets Russes und spiegelt die Vereinigung von Choreographie und fiktiven sowie realen Charakteren wider, die seine künstlerische Welt angetrieben hat.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 4, 5 und 12
classica.us.description: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feierte Beethovens 250. Geburtstag mit der Aufnahme all seiner sechzehn Streichquartette. Im Herbst 2020 präsentierte das Ensemble das gesamte Meisterwerk in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris.

classica.us.title: House of Dreams
classica.us.description: Ein fantasievolles Konzert führt mit barocker Musik auf eine magische, musikalische Reise. Das Ensemble des Tafelmusik Barock Orchester hat sich auf historische Performances spezialisiert. Ihre Musik trifft auf barocke Kunst.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte.

abcperth.au.title: You Can't Ask That - Wheelchair Users
abcperth.au.description: Misunderstood, marginalised Australians answering anonymous, online questions. Insightful, irreverent and moving, this episode sets the record straight of what it's really like to be a wheelchair user. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Murdoch Mysteries - House of Industry
abcperth.au.description: When a reporter investigating conditions at a workhouse is murdered, Murdoch goes undercover to investigate. (Drama)

abcperth.au.title: Grand Designs Australia - Sutton Farm
abcperth.au.description: Returning to sixth generational family land, Sam along with wife Selina, build an off-grid forever home for their three sons from beloved Canberra Red bricks. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Long Lost Family
abcperth.au.description: We meet Christine Gillard who for almost 50 years has lived with the pain of having given up her firstborn daughter, not once but twice. And Robert Lindsay, searching for the Croatian dad he has never met. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Antiques Roadshow - Cromford Mills 3
abcperth.au.description: The Roadshow returns to the historical Cromford Mills in Derbyshire, founded by the father of the Industrial Revolution, Sir Richard Arkwright. Mark Hill meets a pilot who has constructed her own planes. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Hard Quiz
abcperth.au.description: Australia's smartest alecs brave Tom Gleeson's wit to be crowned Hard Quiz champion. Zara's in the tank for Timberlake, Suzanne's red-hot for Radiohead, Alex is barracking for Obama, and Paul's crazy for classic Holdens. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: ABC News WA - Friday 16 October 2026
abcperth.au.description: News from where we live. ABC News WA brings you today's top stories and original reporting on the issues that matter to West Australians. Presented by Charlotte Hamlyn, sport with Tom Wildie, and weather with Pip Waller. (News)

abcperth.au.title: Gardening Australia
abcperth.au.description: Costa and the crew return in a refreshed season full of inspiring stories, practical ideas and beautiful gardens. Your weekly fix of gardening goodness starts here. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Death Valley - Death Valley - S
abcperth.au.description: John and Janie unravel a mystery involving a murder at a school reunion, a cold case, and a shocking discovery from Janie's past. John risks their friendship with unexpected news. (Final). (Comedy)

abcperth.au.title: Recipe of the Year
abcperth.au.description: Adam Liaw and Pia Miranda host this heartfelt cooking competition. Under the watchful eye of the iconic Country Women's Association, home cooks from across Australia compete with the recipes that tell their stories. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Class Clowns
abcperth.au.description: Geography and gymnastics are on the timetable today. Our comedians must name a series of iconic Aussie landmarks before putting on an artistic floor routine in front of Olympic gymnast Isabella Wang. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: Crime Night!
abcperth.au.description: Julia Zemiro is joined by criminologists Professor Danielle Reynald and Dr David Bartlett, plus comedians Rhys Nicholson and Claire Hooper to explore romance scams, with guest Casey Donovan sharing her own remarkable story. (Special Interest)

abcperth.au.title: ABC Late News - Friday 16 October 2026
